text: 10 OVERDOSAGE PROCRIT overdosage can cause hemoglobin levels above the desired level, which should be managed with discontinuation or reduction of PROCRIT dosage and/or with phlebotomy, as clinically indicated [see Pharmacodynamics (12.2) ] . Cases of severe hypertension have been observed following overdose with ESAs [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4) ].
